sites.name: Taflalut Deighim, the Cart Convoy (V3)
sites.storm: storm-dusk at its worst: dust sheets and gusts; dust drifts on the lee side of every cart
sites.story: B04 (no voice): the carts they left all at once; HUD CARTS · 5 · LEFT LOADED at 790; the host remembers "the carts lined up with a lamp on the last one" at 790
sites.style: MedievalVillage cart beds + the AshesOfBazaar handcart, chest, lamp and jars
sites.layout:
bank:            C3 tipped toward the road, its spill fanned out below it   (a lone wheel behind)
  ======== road 786-834 m, a 230 m straight, travel -> ======== the core stays clear ========
  tail lamp  C5 [barrel+lamp]  C4 [barrels]   <gap>   C2 [chest, sacks]  C1 AB handcart on its wheels ->
     ruts from the road edge to each cart; dust in the lee (down-road, outward); shrubs against them
  the dead shade tree + the cold hearth and its pot            C2's wheels stood beside it
sites.notes: Story set V3 on the road site S05_CartConvoy. The V1 dressing (setdress_sites.json S05_CartConvoy_000..036) is removed by `clear` first. Five carts because the HUD counts five. Nothing religious, nothing modern; no people; the lamp is never lit (no light, no emissive).
story_owned: V3 the cart convoy (this file is the story set)

view_notes.carrier_a: approach, 70 m out: the file, the tree and C3 across the road (capture_look eye 2.5 m)
view_notes.carrier_b: road 790: the HUD line and the host's "lamp on the last one" (capture_look eye 2.5 m)
view_notes.carrier_c: road 803: abeam the last cart, looking up the file (capture_look eye 2.5 m)
view_notes.cinp04: CIN_P04 shots 1 and 4: road 700, eye 1.22 m, straight up the road, pitch -3
view_notes.contact: the last cart from its outer side: bed on the ground, dust, the lamp
view_notes.contact_b: the tipped cart on the bank edge: its rail on the ground, the spill
view_notes.far300: from the flat 300 m down-road and right
